reference: Bash type/help metadata from the documented fsfreeze interface. Real FIFREEZE/FITHAW requests require the explicit disposable VM or syscall mock prerequisites below.
coverage: Builtin registration and complete help metadata only; zero executed freeze/thaw operation cases.
exclusions: No fsfreeze action flag is executed in this suite. Real FIFREEZE/FITHAW calls require a dedicated disposable VM, a freezable test filesystem, and CAP_SYS_ADMIN; this runner provides no reviewed syscall mock.
No parser or error-path invocation is used because fsfreeze is a kernel-facing loadable and the allowed runnable loadable checks here are Bash type/help metadata.

cases.purpose: Verify that the candidate registers fsfreeze as a Bash builtin, using Bash type -t metadata without invoking the loadable.
Verify the Bash help builtin exposes the synopsis and documentation declared for fsfreeze, without issuing a freeze or thaw request.
cases.stdout:
fsfreeze: Suspend or resume access to a filesystem
    Suspend or resume access to a filesystem.
    
        fsfreeze -f | --freeze    MOUNTPOINT
        fsfreeze -u | --unfreeze  MOUNTPOINT
    
    Uses the FIFREEZE / FITHAW ioctls; requires root and a freezable fs.

cases.purpose: Check a successful freeze request against a dedicated supported filesystem and confirm the command returns without output.
cases.reason: Success needs CAP_SYS_ADMIN over the filesystem's user namespace and a freezable filesystem; uid 2000 has no capabilities, every filesystem mountable inside an unprivileged user namespace (tmpfs, proc) lacks freeze support, and ext4/xfs cannot be mounted without init-namespace CAP_SYS_ADMIN and a block device.

cases.purpose: After a successful freeze on the same disposable mount, check a successful thaw and verify ordinary access resumes.
cases.reason: Remaining obligations: r1: unchanged: needs a frozen freezable filesystem

cases.purpose: Check status and action-specific diagnostics when the kernel ioctl rejects a freeze or thaw request.
cases.reason: Remaining obligations: r4: usage diagnostics wording not asserted

cases.purpose: Verify the documented behavior that a symlink operand is followed to a directory on the disposable filesystem for freeze and subsequent thaw.
cases.reason: Remaining obligations: r1: successful freeze/thaw through a symlink needs a freezable filesystem (CAP_SYS_ADMIN)
